knowledge.name: card news layouts
knowledge.description: Card news templates in four systems: paper, Index, Nocturne, and Gallery. Copy one system and change only the words.

contents.description: Paper desk, 1080×1350. Six slides in one file: cover, text, score, steps, screen, and cta. Pair only with design-4.md. Copy the card whose data-layout matches the slide.
Index cover, 1080×1350. Cream field, black left rail, one red signal. Pair only with design-1.md.
Nocturne cover, 1080×1350. Warm black field, serif title, antique gold rule. Pair only with design-2.md.
Gallery cover, 1080×1350. Warm paper, cropped oxblood circle, italic serif. Pair only with design-3.md.
